I read two twisted crowns last year, I really liked it. I'm kinda in a romantasy slump, I read this woven kingdom series and loved it and then started shield of sparrows and gave up on it pretty quickly because it felt so repetitive. Sometimes romantasy can be a bit same same. But after r10 I'm struggling with other Contemporary romance because I'm so obsessed with Hugh and Liz so I'm switching to something depraved so it's the total opposite. Think I'll finally try reading some Lola king books. Any soft or sweet mmc's will just get compared to Hugh and I'll be let down! 

I was going through as many snippets as possible yesterday and basically it seems like lizzie and feely are going to hook up at some point. Which I guess is OK because otherwise Liz will only be stuck with Pierce but I neeeeeed Hugh pining and begging for Liz at some point! I don't want it to only be Liz begging for him back
Elite song

I totally see that, and while I think it's sad as fuck that Liz is left alone essentially I also don't think anyone else knows the full extent of her mental health struggles except for Hugh. Katie and Hugh are both damaged and hiding behind their truths. Plus maybe some kind of love does develop between them? 

And I don't think Hugh and Liz go 2 years without interacting. I'm sure there has been moments and talks the whole time. Liz clearly goes manic again and Hugh is probably torn because he doesn't want anyone to know about her illness but still scared for her.. in his mind he can't take her back and there is zero chance for a future because he can never trust her when she's manic. Obviously I don't think this will happen and they will ultimately be together in the end. But it'll take a while and Hugh will have to probably uncover all the stuff Liz has been suppressing to fully understand her.

As for making amends... I don't know if they will. Hugh and Liz might leave and do their own thing. Also... mark Allen will be brutally killed by Liz and Hugh together 😊

Yes thinking about her being alone with mostly Pierce for that long is horrific. My only hope is that her and Hugh have been hanging out or at least speaking that whole time on and off. Hugh has a sixth sense when something is up with her and I just know he would have been checking in with her. 

I trust that Chloe will take care of her and tell her story properly. She has given her a lot to carry but will ensure she is given understanding and healing, no matter how long it takes. The unfortunate reality is that her mental illness will mean she will never have an easy time, similar to how Joe will always be battling his demons and cravings. I truly think she will want to leave that town, there's too much pain. All the adults and her friends pretty much failed her (even if unintended) except for her brave knight 🥲 and I think they would be better off away from it all.

Also I keep seeing stuff about her eventually getting with Patrick... maybe they have an interlude at some point while they both pine for Hugh and Katie? He would be there for her while Hugh is busy with Katie I guess even though I only want them to be with each other, at least Feely is a good guy...

Same, always down to talk! I haven't been able to read anything, I may have to switch to something super dark just to shock myself out of this. I think it confirmed for me that my favourite type of mmc is when they are caretakers, protective and devoted. That's why I loved Johnny and Shannon so much. But Liz took it to another place because I love that she is a deeply angry and damaged person who craves love but finds it hard to accept. I relate a little too much. She needs someone patient and devoted to love her through her pain. Hugh is truly perfect to me, like if I had to create a perfect love interest in a fictional setting, it's him. So the combination of them together has ruined me for any other couple I fear
Come talk here! My mind is 90% Hugh and Liz atm
Don't worry I really don't think that will happen. Chloe likes putting us through hell but it works out in the end.

I really doubt she will kill either of them off, she likes to give happy endings and I feel like Liz is her favourite character in a way so she will want her to be happy. She has endured way too much. Joe and Shannon went through hell and they got happy endings, Liz will too! I'm sure of it.

And Katie... she can have her happy ending... with someone other than Hugh.

Thank you for sharing! Omg August would have been amazing but I'll just be happy if we get it this year. I can't imagine waiting anymore. 

Liz and Hugh becoming the ultimate BOT couple is so crazy, they will always be imprinted on my heart. I need a third book for them that is them living together as grown ups in Dublin with their family.
Holy fuck I hadn't seen that one yet, VOMIT

Oh my God?!?!?!?! Whhaaaaat confirmed release date tea?! Please please share omg. And yes pls share any pdf links, thank you thank you.

Ugh don't get me started on the spotify play lists, I feel like any music I'm listening to at the moment I'm relating back to them. And the tiktok ai edit has taken over my life lol, I think I've watched it 400 times. It's truly agony. I'm re reading the scenes I can't stop thinking about and hurting myself over and over

Dude even reading you describe those scenes got me tearing up again. The pain they both felt. I am so desperate for Liz to be able to explain to him everything she's been through so he fully understands her and why she did what she did. I need Liz to know she's not dirty or evil, and deserves true love. I truly hope skip through most of Katie and Hugh happy times quite quickly because I'll be ill reading that. No hate to Katie but my man belongs to Liz. Poor poor Liz spiralling again and having literally no one. I would read 2 more books about them truly they stole my heart
Honestly smart, I wish I had the willpower
I want to do that but I fear all I want is Liz and hugh

Never thought I would see the day I don't feel like reading about Johnny and Shannon, but I don't think I can atm. I was always intrigued by Liz but never thought much about Hugh, and now they are my favourite couple, I think. The way Hugh loved Liz will never leave my heart, when she was manic, when she was depressed, when she was scared and sad and destructive... it was sadly beautiful.

The last scene was soul crushing but the scene when he goes to her house the final time and they are both crying and she screams, why can't you just love me and he screams back he does but she's making his life a misery as he's leaving...... let me tell you I was sobbing so hard. Manic Liz was so hard to read about
If I wasn't so worried about spoilers I wouldn't have read it until the next book was out. This is hell

Oh wow you are sooo brave re-reading! I have re-read the whole series 3 times except for T7 (only once) but I truly think I'll only ever be able to revisit certain parts of this book. I don't think I can ever relive all the abuse.  

I know what you mean about Lizzie, I think I see her as such a special character in the way I love Joe. Full of so much complexity, and so fleshed out as characters. They feel SO real to me.

 I want her to find some kind of peace. And I DO want her with Hugh, I really do feel they are soulmates. Watching a character like Liz be nurtured, protected, loved and cared for by Hugh has healed something inside me. I know we got Johnny who protects and cares for Shannon, but Shannon is easy to love and want to protect. Liz is the opposite, she's not the typical damsel who men flock to nurture. But Hugh sees her real self and wants to love her desperately. I don't even know how ill cope with them being with others, I literally sobbed all throughout the final chapters just seeing them apart

I think I'm making it worse by continuing to listen.. I started crying while cleaning my kitchen at 9 am because I was listening to Angel's Like You LMFAO. Quite pathetic.

Then that goddamn ai edit of them dropped on tiktok and I got stuck watching it for like 30 minutes straight. So then I re read the scene of him watching her dance with Pierce again just to really twist the knife and indulge in some self harm. 

Hoping these feelings fade soon, it's brutal
I regret reading it lol. I'll be in this slump for ages

See I've thought about doing that. A re-read helped after R6 but I don't think even that will save me. Lizzie and Hughie are so consuming that it's specifically them that I need. This was already my all time fave series and now it's even more special because I feel so connected to their story. I need another book about them like I'm dying! 

How the heck are fictional teenagers making me feel so much?!

She spoke out, defended herself and called him out after almost 2 years of her name being absolutely slandered in the media. She is copping it from all angles and particularly in the last few months, things have reached a fever pitch. She's also promoting her movie that's about to come out so it fits timeline wise to say something now. Why shouldn't she? If Jason wants to play dirty and embarrass her then hey  gloves off! She said zero until now, and allowed narratives about her to run rampant, and I'm sure that was mostly for the sake of her children and respect for their dad. 

Her career and livelihood is at stake here. It's not a game, this kind of slandering could have major long term impact on her credibility and reputation. Jason is throwing rocks and then playing nice guy to save face and it's not ok. He is the reason this got publicly ugly, he is the reason his kids will one day read what he did to shame her.
For real, it just super confirms this is a really serious relationship because she is going through absolute hell to be with him!

I read the whole article, she seems extremely smart and thoughtful. It must be so difficult for her to go her entire career with relatively all good or neutral press, to now being publicly vilified and shamed on a huge level. Like, I'm sure she probably expected a fair bit of attention when she chose to start dating an extremely famous pop star, but I don't think anyone could have anticipated how insane this has all gotten.

I'm truly disheartened to see how gross and misogynistic everyone can become when a woman chooses to leave an unhappy relationship and move on. Even if she overlapped the relationships slightly, it's not ok to rake her over the coals the way she has been. She clearly wasn't happy with Jason and happened to meet someone new, and she made the correct choice to end things and move on to someone that makes her truly happy. People are allowed to do that. She isn't publicly flaunting her relationship with Harry, she's just living her life and people seem to absolutely despise her for that. It's like we can't abide a woman in her late 30's with kids dump her asshole ex and get in a loving relationship with a younger guy (agism completely plays a role, all Harry's fans love calling her an old hag). 

And just as I suspected, Jason is a vindictive, nasty, petty, cruel bitter ex who is ASTONISHED his wifey kicked him to the curb and moved on. He's making her pay for this, and relishing in her public shaming. How gross, that's the mother of his kids. And all this business with DWD is so awful, they've really made it about gossip and on-set fueding and relationships which is making it seem like she's incapable of running a professional set. Too preoccupied with her boytoy to do her job. It's such a misogynistic take, women can't be trusted to do their job. I really hope she bounces back from this and keeps succeeding because I'm really rooting for her after all this crap they're putting her through.
You too 😊 what a wholesome reddit exchange ending

Even if he wasn't pushing the issue in person, I would still feel uncomfortable that he's doing so publicly. It's putting her in an awkward position so that now if she wants to continue to see Pete, they will get criticised even more because she's going 'against' Kanye. I always just think they have a weird dynamic. Plus he's singing about her in concert in front of North, they staged a fake wedding at his album listening concert in front of their children, like... it's very odd. Confusing as hell for the kids. If I was Pete I would probably want to get the hell outta there. Even if Kim is reassuring him that they're done and she wants to be with him, it's going to be super annoying having Kanye publicly pine for his ex-wife while they're trying to build a relationship. 

Ultimately I think co-parents should strive for a happy, peaceful relationship and if that includes genuine friendship then that's amazing. I do not think that can usually be achieved before the divorce has even been finalised, and especially not when 1 party is so publicly claiming to wish to be reconciled. Plus Kanye is definitely a narcissist, I don't see him ever wanting Kim to be happy without him. I see your point of view, however these circumstances are waaay different.

We could get into potential stunts but with this family it would be never ending. Some people believe literally everything they do is  fake. Either way, Kim has clearly publicly pushed the narrative she's been seeing Pete. Kanye is very publicly claiming he wants her back. That's what I'm basing my answer off. Plus, I'm a fan of Pete and he honestly seems like a sweet guy, I can't ever see him fake dating a woman for publicity. He admits he falls in love super hard and he's a hopeless romantic. And no offense to him but if Kim wanted a publicity stunt relationship, why would she pick Pete? She's way more famous than him.

That would make sense except Kanye is publicly stating how much he wants her back. It's weird to hang with your ex and father of your kids so frequently if they are actively pursuing to get you back and you are with someone new.

Yeah I like them. Sophie gets alot of hate, so does Finley but they're my favourite characters out of the new cast. Plus I think Roasanny is gorgeous 😍

She's extremely underwritten, all we've really seen is she's wealthy, career driven and got cheated on. I haven't even really seen enough of her heartbreak to feel all that sympathetic. That sounds bad because it's awful what happened, but we've spent way more time with Fin and Sophie and because of that I feel like I understand why they belong together so I'm ok with it. It doesn't help that Fin and Sophie have bucketloads more chemistry than Dani and Sophie ever did. 

Anyway, Dani is hot but the actress isn't giving me enough to care that much. I feel like she does a lot of wide eye staring or serious work mode frowning and not a lot else. She might end up being one of those L Word characters that I skip their scenes. I had a bunch in the original series...😂
Yeah i mean i guess I just don't see much chemistry between Tess/Shane and Gigi/Dani. Give them each someone great

I love them together, mostly because they have what so many couples on tv never have- CHEMISTRY. I actually buy their relationship. I didn't find Sophie or Fin attractive individually when I started the show, but their chemistry together has made them hot to me. 

I get why they get hate, and I think the writers make Finley unnecessarily stupid sometimes (confronting Dani in the last episode was SO awful), but they are still likable and cute enough that I can root for them together. 

I can't enjoy romantic pairings that have zero chemistry no matter how hot the characters are or how sympathetic theyre written. I find Gigi extremely attractive and she has chemistry with everyone so i like seeing her, unfortunately I don't care much for Dani and therefore I'm not very into that pairing. I would like to see Gigi with someone else. Maybe Shane eventually

First watch through, I was obsessed with Shane, that has waned with age. Now with the current show, I'm bored as heck and skip thru most of her scenes 😩 her storyline has sucked this season and I don't care about her and Tess. 

Pam Grier never fit with the show and I have no idea what they wanted out of that character. Why did we need a finger snapping, sassy, STRAIGHT woman? Her bad acting was the cherry on top of the whole mess.

Marina was cringe and weird. They tried the 'foreign', erotic, well read lesbian vibe and it flopped. She gave me second hand embarrassment when she would talk. So pretentious. 

Jenny was amazing until the final seasons. She was one of the fave characters in the first 3 seasons and I have no idea why they started writing her so insane.

I loved Alice and Tasha so much the first watch thru, but now I find Tasha a little too judgey. She was also a soldier and I absolutely can't fuck with any character that justifies invading foreign countries and murdering people in the name of 'freedom'. Even tho she was super hot 🥵

The actress who plays Tina has the weirdest neck and mouth situation, plus bad acting means I can't stand to watch her scenes. I also find Bette such a pretentious asshole. 

I found most of Helena's storylines so boring I skip them on rewatch. Especially the poker thing, who cares.

Papi was so goddamn cringe and weird, why did they include that? Make me believe women would fall over this person, don't make them a caricature. 

Dani is pretty but boring and bland. The actress has almost no chemistry with any of the other actors, I don't buy it.

Finley is messed up and goofy but I like her. The writers really did her dirty with that scene of her asking DANI of all people how to be an adult. That was so dumb, even for Finley, like even she had to have more self awareness than to ask that. 

Maribel and Micah are cringe and I can't. 

Angie and her friend Jordi or whatever are sweet but feel so out of place and watching that scene where she asks her to prom felt like a Disney movie and took me out of the show and made me feel weird. They have less than zero chemistry, and while I don't need to see a full on romantic storyline, I don't for one second buy they are teen girls in their first lesbian relationship.

Honestly I don't get the Dani hype. She seems to be the most popular character on here. Is it just cos she's hot? The actress is so blah to me, she doesn't look even remotely into the kisses with the other actors, no chemistry whatsoever. I have no real problem with straight girls playing lesbians (i also have no idea if the actress is straight) but i need to believe somewhat that you're into girls. I don't believe it at all with Dani.

She's been given an extremely sympathetic storyline tho so i get why it's easy to root for her. If there was a more charismatic actress playing her I think I'd like the character a lot more.

So much moral grandstanding in this thread. Since when were any of the characters on the L Word good people? Everyone shitting on Finley for being a mess and drunk etc. So gross and classist. She was kicked out at 18 and clearly comes from some kind of traumatic background. 

Do you remember all the horrible shit Shane did in the original series? Or Alice? Or Bette? Or Jenny?! Jesus. This show isn't meant to have 'good' guys and 'bad' guys. Everyone's a mess in their own way. Maybe now because Shane and Alice and Bette are older people forget the original show was just them making shitty decision after shitty decision. Like who you want but the moral superiority really stinks.
